title: Vibrant Italian Pasta Bake
description: A colorful pasta dish loaded with flavors of Italy, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This vibrant bake combines pasta, vegetables, and cheese for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the garlic, onion, bell peppers, and zucchini. Cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the vibrant sauce and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked pasta, vegetables, and sauce. Mix well to combine.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle the baked mozzarella on top.
Season with italian seasoning and a pinch of salt.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let it rest for a few minutes before serving.
